LOWER(string_to_transform)
Returns the input string, transformed to lowercase. This function is not unicode
aware.
Parameters
string_to_transform: The string to transform.
Returns
The lowercase version of the string.
#Example
You might compare an incoming field of unknown case to a set of known values as
follows:
LOWER(/ticker) IN ('msft', 'ibm', 'rhat', 'dis')
